beats.intro: Chapter twenty. [[sub]]A C I D: four promises that keep your money real.
beats.ground: Ravi sends 500 rupees to Meena. [[accts]]His account holds 1000, hers holds 500. [[move]]Step one: subtract 500 from Ravi. Step two: add 500 to Meena. [[crash]]Now the power dies between the steps. [[half]]Ravi lost 500, Meena got nothing. Half a job is worse than no job. [[w]]Write this: a transfer is two steps that must succeed or fail together.
beats.txn: That all-or-nothing job has a name. [[unit]]A transaction is one logical unit of work. [[ok]]It travels: Active, to Partially Committed, to Committed. Committed means done and safe. [[fail]]Or it travels: Failed, to Aborted. Aborted means rolled back, as if it never ran. [[w]]Write this: transaction equals one logical unit; committed or aborted, never half.
beats.acid: Four promises, one per letter. [[a]]A: atomicity. All or nothing. The light switch cannot be half on. [[c]]C: consistency. The rules of the game hold before and after. No negative balances. [[i]]I: isolation. Concurrent transfers get separate rooms; nobody sees half-written numbers. [[d]]D: durability. Committed means carved in stone: power cuts cannot erase it. [[w]]Write this: all, correct, isolated, durable, one transfer example each.
beats.q1: Quick check. [[q]]Debit succeeded, credit failed, so the debit is undone. Which property?
beats.isol: Isolation comes in strengths, weakest first. [[l1]]Read Uncommitted: dirty reads allowed. You may read numbers nobody committed. [[l2]]Read Committed: no dirty reads. [[l3]]Repeatable Read: a row you read twice cannot change under you. New rows may still appear. [[l4]]Serializable: full isolation, as if transfers ran one after another. Strength rises, freedom falls. [[w]]Write this: order the four levels, name what each still allows.
beats.q2: Quick check. [[q]]Power cut right after commit, but the data is still there after restart. Which property?
beats.wrap: To sum up. [[w1]]A transaction is one logical unit: committed or aborted, never half. [[w2]]A is all-or-nothing, C is correct state, I is separate rooms, D is carved in stone. Recovery guards A and D; concurrency control guards I. [[w3]]Isolation ladder weakest to strongest: Uncommitted, Committed, Repeatable, Serializable.
beats.final2: Chapter practice. [[q]]Which component mainly ensures isolation?
beats.final3: Chapter practice. [[q]]True or false: Read Committed can see uncommitted changes.
beats.finish: Well done. Money is safe. Next stop: C A P, the most misquoted theorem in the subject.
